options.query_instruction: Given a Chinese literary quotation, retrieve the literary theme concepts whose meanings are expressed or strongly implied by the quotation. Match concepts by meaning, including implicit themes, rather than by keyword overlap alone.

notes: Route 3: retrieve an internal top-20 candidate pool using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, then rerank quote/Theme pairs using Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B.
Only the final top-3/top-5 metrics are headline metrics; candidate-pool size is an internal route parameter.
Theme document representation is fixed to canonical label + definition + aliases.
